mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates strong demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% over the past six months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the past month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declines by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals accommodative monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE < 4%.
